The payroll computes contributions, not the Board's demand. Seed `CPF_MONTHLY_SUBMISSION_AND_PAYMENT` timing said "from the day after the due date, minimum $5" — a wrong transcription, fixed in place in all 80 settings rows (reg.3(3)–(5) text); `statutory-golden-sg` (2026-09-28, round 2) "IR8A, IR21 and CPF late interest are dated external obligations…" proves it in every sealed version. The CPF page's round-down-to-dollar example is Board practice, not in reg.3. Legacy status: Yes. Period: Continuing, in force before 2025-12; employer paying after due date.
